early_stop: dev loss rises at 3 consecutive dev evals

recovery.pass: bitwise model+optimizer digests, batch fingerprints and losses for every replayed update; numerical continuation only with a recorded SIGTERM stop, a restore, identical batch fingerprints for every replayed update and equal update counts

evaluation.multiplicity: Holm across the categories that have a base few-shot view (factuality, math, instruction following, JSON)

G-REG.rule: no category with candidate < base few-shot and Holm-adjusted McNemar p < 0.05

gates.G-REC: stage 3 passes AND the pilot's final checkpoint verifies and reproduces its recorded dev loss exactly
gates.EARLY-STOP: the pilot completed its registered updates and dev loss never rose at three consecutive dev evaluations

supersedes.reason: final independent pre-measurement review: scorer and MBPP isolation fixes (dataset/bundle v1.2) and pipeline/decision fixes (recovery signalling, strict G-REC, early-stop enforcement)
